guest_title: Ringmasters, 2012 International Quartet Champions. Director of Zero8.
title_card_line: Ringmasters, 2012 International Quartet Champions  |  Director of Zero8
_cold_note: Each clip re-transcribed alone to confirm clean edges (media/rasmus/clips).
cold: We have 10 choirs that would easily be able to go on tour as a professional group, but they're not. They're just amateur choirs singing on a very high level.
If we're going to perform on a high level, the very first thing we need to do together is get it off paper. That's where it starts for me.
I would want government-level awareness to the positive effects of singing, and therefore funding.
